symptom: Repair v42 passed partial candidate validation, materialization, full-pack preflight, static balance budget, playable content coverage audit, GameCore validate-content, and isolated validate-candidates, but failed the 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. RouteBot remained inside target at 33.3% against a 10%-35% target and CowardBot recovered to 33.3% against a 10%-35% target, but GreedyXpBot and ZoneControlBot stayed high at 66.7% against a 25%-55% target, KiteBot stayed high at 100.0% against a 45%-75% target, and TankBot rose to 100.0% against a 25%-55% target.
root_cause: The v42 repair softened v41's map-size reduction from 2300x1500 to 2450x1600. This preserved the useful RouteBot pressure from smaller fixed-route radius and reduced the CowardBot overcorrection, but it still compressed active movement, XP collection, and kill pacing enough to make most non-idle active policies too reliable. The failure confirms that map-size reduction is a broad global lever: even a softer midpoint changes too many movement policies at once.
fix: Do not promote v42 into accepted_content, Runtime content, simulated_candidates, or playtest_candidates. Keep v38 as the current BossHunter-repaired base until a candidate passes the all-Bot smoke matrix. Stop using broad map-size reductions as the primary RouteBot repair lever. For the next repair, use a narrower content-side lever that targets RouteBot's safe fixed route or late-route sustain without globally shortening traversal, such as a lane-pressure enemy mix adjustment in a narrow time window, a map hazard candidate with explicit counterplay, or a targeted wave pressure redistribution that avoids changing starter weapon feel.
validation: v42 reports are in harness/reports/2026-06-02_demo_buildcraft_repair_v42_* and the failed smoke matrix is harness/reports/2026-06-02_demo_buildcraft_repair_v42_matrix_300s_3seed_71000_001/summary.md. The same matrix shows IdleBot 0/3, RandomBot 0/3, CowardBot 1/3, BossHunterBot 2/3, and RouteBot 1/3 passing, but GreedyXpBot 2/3, KiteBot 3/3, TankBot 3/3, and ZoneControlBot 2/3 outside target. The next candidate must rerun the same 71000-71002 all-Bot smoke matrix and should be rejected if broad active-Bot win rates remain above target.
